这是一个非常简单的工作流程，可帮助您将 Mage Flow 文本到图像生成数据保存到人类可读的 .txt 文件中。这将自动获取您的元数据并将其写入 .txt 文件。您将在具有工作流程的存档 (.Zip) 中找到它使用图像生成的所有保存的提示文件。此外，通过此处使用的 Image Saver Simple 节点，您可以将工作流程本身嵌入到每个保存的图像中，或者单独保存工作的图像和工作流程。

Mage-Flow 由 Microsoft 开发，是一个紧凑的 4B 参数生成堆栈，专为高效的文本到图像生成和基于指令的图像编辑而设计。虽然替代框架通常依赖于大规模的数百亿参数架构或与高分辨率瓶颈作斗争，但 Mage-Flow 通过仔细的分词器-主干系统协同设计实现了最先进的竞争质量。它将超轻量级 Mage-VAE 潜在分词器与通过整流流匹配训练的本机分辨率多模态扩散变压器 (NR-MMDiT) 配对。此外，Mage-Flow 本质上擅长处理可变长宽比和极端尺寸（从 512 到 2048 像素），无需补丁或填充，利用系统级优化（如本机分辨率打包和融合 CUDA 内核）来提供交互式、低延迟的生成和 编辑速度。在我的使用过程中，我对它的速度感到惊讶 - 在我的系统上使用此工作流程，它的运行速度甚至比 SDXL 1.0 还要快。但唯一的缺点是我发现它生成的图像质量更接近某些 SD 1.5 模型，并具有正确渲染一些短单词或短语的额外好处，它在现阶段难以处理复杂的图像（包含太多人或太长的文本或太多的设计元素）。在某些方面它比 Flux.2 Klein 4B 更好，但在其他方面它无法击败 Flux.2 Klein 4B。我可以肯定地看到它是理想的用例 - 快速粗略的想法构建，稍后可以通过像 Krea 2 这样的更精细的模型进行微调。

您可以从 CivitAI 的 HuggingFace 和 LORA 下载此工作流程中使用的必要模型文件（详细信息如下所述）。确保您安装了足够最新的 ComfyUI，并使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装此工作流程所需的任何必要节点，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。另请查看我的其他工作流程：Krea 2、SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、Pony、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、MagicWAN Image v2、QWEN、HunyuanImage-2.1、HiDream O1、Ernie Image、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow、NoobAI、Illustrious、Lumina2、Z-Image Turbo、Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B、 Flux.1 Dev 和 Kandinsky Image 5 Lite（T2I 和 I2I）模型。请随意在您喜欢的其他内容（LORA、实用程序、数据集等）上添加一些黄色 Buzz 我。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Mage Flow 模型文件，然后

#2.设置您想要的图像尺寸开始

＃3。然后输入你想要的图片提示。

＃4。选择您想要的图像数量（更改“运行”按钮旁边的数字）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、CFG、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮生成。就是这样..

** 此工作流程的 LORA 使用是可选的，您可以在没有任何 LORA 的情况下使用它，也可以与 1 或 2 个或任何其他数量的 LORA 一起使用，要添加新的 LORA，请按顶部的 L 按钮在新选项卡上的 LORA Manager 中找到您的 LORA，如果您想使用该 LORA，只需单击向上的 Kite 按钮。

o.en:
This is a very simple workflow that helps you to save your Mage Flow Text to Image Generation Data into a human readable .txt file. This will automatically get and write your metadata to the .txt file. You will find all the saved prompt files that it generated with the images inside the Archive (.Zip) that has the workflow. Also with the Image Saver Simple node used here you may embed the workflow itself with each saved image or save the image and workflow for your work separately.

Developed by Microsoft, Mage-Flow is a compact 4B-parameter generative stack designed specifically for efficient text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing. While alternative frameworks often rely on massive multi-tens-of-billions parameter architectures or struggle with high-resolution bottlenecks, Mage-Flow achieves state-of-the-art-competitive quality through careful tokenizer-backbone-system co-design. It pairs the ultra-lightweight Mage-VAE latent tokenizer with a Native-Resolution Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (NR-MMDiT) trained via rectified flow matching. Furthermore, Mage-Flow inherently excels at handling variable aspect ratios and extreme dimensions (from 512 to 2048 pixels) without requiring patches or padding, leveraging system-level optimizations like native-resolution packing and fused CUDA kernels to deliver interactive, low-latency generation and editing speeds. In my usage I was surprised how fast this was - it worked even faster than SDXL 1.0 with this workflow on my system. But it's only drawback I have found that it's generated image quality is more close to some SD 1.5 models with added benefit of correctly rendering some short words or phrases, it has difficulty of handling complex images (with too many people or too long texts or too many design elements) in it's current stage. In some ways it's better than Flux.2 Klein 4B but in other ways it fails to beat Flux.2 Klein 4B. I can definately see it's ideal use case - rapid rough idea buildups which can later be fine tuned via more fine model like Krea 2.

You can download your necessary model files used in this workflow from HuggingFace and LORA from CivitAI (Details are mentioned below). Make sure you have latest enough ComfyUI installation and install any necessary nodes for for this workflow using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for Krea 2, SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, Pony, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, MagicWAN Image v2, QWEN, HunyuanImage-2.1, HiDream O1, Ernie Image, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow, NoobAI, Illustrious, Lumina2, Z-Image Turbo, Flux.2 Klein 9B & 4B, Flux.1 Dev and Kandinsky Image 5 Lite (T2I & I2I) models. Feel free to toss some yellow Buzz on other stuffs (LORAs, utilities, Datasets etc.) you like from me.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Mage Flow model files first and

#2. set your desired image dimensions to start

#3. then input your desired image prompt.

#4. select how many images you want (Change the number besides the "Run" button)

#5. select image sampling methods, CFG, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button to generate. That's it..

** LORA usage for this workflow is optional you can use it without any LORAs, use with 1 or 2 or any other number of LORAs, to add new LORAs press the L button on top to lunch LORA Manager on a new tab find your LORA and if you want to use that LORA just click the upward Kite button.
